tool_input.command:
set -u
T=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$T/src"; printf 'a\n' > "$T/src/a.txt"
for s in 20260101-120000 20260102-120000 20260103-120000 20260104-120000; do
  BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash rotate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 # noop, just ensure rotate.sh/verify.sh parse
  BACKUP_STAMP=$s bash backup.sh --quiet --dest "$T/dest" --name demo "$T/src" >/dev/null
done
echo "--- rotate --keep 2 (4 archives): expect oldest two deleted, newest two kept"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest "$T/dest" --name demo --keep 2
ls "$T/dest" | sort
echo "--- rotate --dry-run --keep 1 on remaining 2: expect 'would delete' oldest"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dry-run --dest "$T/dest" --name demo --keep 1
echo "--- verify --name demo: expect 2 ok lines"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$T/dest" --name demo; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- malformed sidecar (single space): expect BAD ... (malformed sidecar)"
printf '%s  my backup.tar.gz\n' deadbeef > "$T/dest/loose.sha256"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$T/dest" --name loose; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- unknown flag: expect usage + rc=1"
bash rotate.sh --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --bogus 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- --help: expect rc=0"
bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
bash verify.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- --keep=abc: expect rc=1"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$T/dest" --name demo --keep=abc 2>/dev/null; echo "rc=$?"
rm -rf "$T"
for f in rotate.sh verify.sh lib/common.sh tests/run_tests.sh; do bash -n "$f" && echo "syntax ok: $f"; done
tool_input.description: Smoke-test refactored rotate.sh and verify.sh flags and behaviors

tool_input.command: T=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$T/dest"; printf 'payload\n' > "$T/dest/my good.tar.gz"; (cd "$T/dest" && shasum -a 256 "my good.tar.gz" > "my good.tar.gz.sha256"); bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$T/dest"; echo "rc=$?"; rm -rf "$T"
tool_input.description: Verify intact space-named archive with matching sidecar reports ok
Run spaced-name ok check and remove scratch scripts

result: Changed `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added `lib/common.sh` — all 8 tests pass (the two bug fixes verified: `rotate --keep 2` keeps both archives when exactly two exist and deletes the oldest first when rotation is needed; `verify` accepts `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` with a correct checksum), and `backup.sh`/`restore.sh`/`report.sh` were left untouched.
